text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Yukino 
Bijin, we spotted a mobile haunted house. 
However...!
Gyaah! Nano~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ines-san!? Screamin' like that... Were 
ya inside a haunted house?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Yuki-chan and the others...!? 
A-Actually—!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me, so you were workin' part-time 
at a haunted house! And a real ghost is 
showin' up... wild, ain't it?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Exactly~~!! At this rate, scaring the 
visitors is totally out of the 
question...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~ Oh, I know! Could ya let me take a 
look inside? I might be able to figure 
somethin' out...!

(...*whisper whisper*... *giggle*) 
(...*rustle*............ *clatter*!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ayaa, there's definitely... one here. 
Though at this level, it's not much of a 
ghost...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaaaaaa~~h! I-I-It's pitch 
black~~~~~!!!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, totally fine! Uhh, the light 
switch must be... this one!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Uuuu, Yuki-chaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~... Ain't no need to be scared. 
They're just "there", not really doing any 
harm.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"At times like this, it's best to toss 
some salt and just ignore 'em. That's what 
my pa taught me back home, too—"

text_block_list.name: Young Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Daddy~, what's that? There's a weird sound 
following us~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yukino, don't look behind you. Don't 
answer it. That thing ain't human. That 
feeling... It's neither a yokai nor a god.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Father
text_block_list.text:
A ghost, huh? Hahaha! No worries, the 
living are stronger! As long as you don't 
show any fear, it can't do nothin'. Stay 
confident, confident!

text_block_list.name: Young Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haeee, is that so...? Then I gotta pull 
myself together...! *snort*!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—So, there's no need to worry! As long as 
you've got your usual energy, Ines-san, 
it'll definitely be fine.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...! Alright... Then I'll do 
my best to cheer them—!
(Tug, tug...!)
choice_data_list: Did... someone just tug on my jacket?
Did... someone just tug on my jacket?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeh...! I-It wasn't me...! Wh-Wh-Who in 
the world is it~~~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ayaa~, what a stubborn ghost. Mmm~~... 
Geez!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hey! Knock it off!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's troubled by this, ya know! 
Please stop playing pranks!"
(――*freeze!*)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Looks like it got through to 
them. What a relief de gansu~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: My chills suddenly went away...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Yuki-chan...! Y-You're way 
too amazing...!
choice_data_list: Let's stay confident and go for it too.
Let's stay confident and aggressive too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Yuki-chan...! Y-You're way 
too amazing...!
choice_data_list: Let's stay confident and go for it too.
Let's stay confident and aggressive too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
D-Dependable, you say?! Aw shucks, that's 
not...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It was just a harmless spirit, so it 
wasn't scary at all~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"No! You were so resolute and cool! A 
totally cool woman! Thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-what! Resolute...? C-Cool...? E-Ehehe! 
That makes me feel kinda embarrassed...!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! All right... I'm gonna be just like 
Yuki-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
M-Mr. Ghost... Please pass on peacefully 
already...! N-Nahan!
choice_data_list: Get out of here, if ya please~

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wha-whaaat!? Y-You don't need to copy my 
accent, you know~?!
